units.source_text: 这两个人和道子究竟在哪一点上合得来呢？

en.t: In what way did these two people and Michiko really get along?

units.source_text: 我认为，对任何人都好意相待，是容易办到的。

en.t: I thought it was easy enough to treat anyone with goodwill.

units.source_text: 我的期望有点落空，凝望着他们两人。

en.t: My expectations were somewhat disappointed, and I gazed at the two of them.

units.source_text: 我把坐垫移到靠近梳妆台。

en.t: I moved my cushion closer to the dressing table.

units.source_text: 端茶上来时，我也不知该说什么好。

en.t: When the tea was brought in, I too did not know what to say.

units.source_text: 我无缘无由地到了这里，结果不是使道子背弃两人、伤害两人了吗？

en.t: Had I not come here for no real reason and ended up making Michiko betray and hurt the two of them?

units.source_text: 朝仓好不容易才大声招呼和尚，他要同我下围棋，这才把我给解救了。

en.t: Asakura finally managed to call loudly to the priest, saying he wanted to play go with me, and that at last rescued me.
